div.div:
حَجِىءٌ بِهِ Attached to, and tenacious of, him, or it. (Fr, S.) ―
-b2- إِنَّهُ لَحَجِىءٌ إِلَى بَنِى فُلَانٍ Verily he is betaking himself for refuge, or protection, to the sons of such a one. (AZ, K. *) ―
-b3- هُوَ حَجِىءٌ بِكَذَا He is adapted or disposed, apt, meet, suited, suitable, fitted, fit, competent, or proper, for such a thing; or worthy of it: (Lh, K:) a dial. var. of حَجِىٌّ: (Lh:) you say, هُمَا حَجِئَانِ, and هُنَّ حَجَايَا. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
